g1_1_business.what_it_does: Frontier Springs Ltd specializes in manufacturing components for the railway industry, including hot-coiled compression springs, air springs, and forged components. The company primarily serves Indian Railways, providing essential parts for wagons, carriages, and locomotives, including the modern Vande Bharat Express. By focusing on this niche market, Frontier Springs has established itself as a key supplier in the railway sector.

customers.description: The primary customer, requiring components for various railway vehicles.
Supplies to over 102 countries, leveraging IRIS certification.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing plant for springs and forged components.
Manufacturing plant for springs and forged components.

competitive_advantage: Strong regulatory moat as one of only three RDSO-approved air spring manufacturers.
Established relationships with Indian Railways over 30+ years.
IRIS certification for exports, allowing access to international markets.
Specialization in railway components, reducing competition.
Capacity to scale production without significant capital expenditure.

drivers.fact: The company has earmarked a capex of ₹15–20 crores to enhance capacity.
drivers.why_it_matters: This investment is expected to alleviate current capacity constraints and support revenue growth.
drivers.evidence_quote: Earmarked a capex of ₹15–20 crores during the current financial year to further enhance our capacity.
